disclosure: Mechanical evaluation only. No person outside the project has labelled SIG's data or its matching, and no independent human evaluation exists (D-R10-HUMAN-1 — it fires only when the operator records that at least two independent labelers are available, trigger T-EVAL-IND). Every figure below is a mechanical census or sample over the population its row names — never an estimate of real-world precision or recall.

m1_derivation_census.label: share of the run's applied derivation collapses re-verified by the GQ-23 census — a mechanical census over declared copy lineages, never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
m1_derivation_census.population: every applied C0–C2 derivation collapse of the latest completed camera-site ER run

m1b_id_resolution_sample.label: share of a seeded per-namespace sample of C1 collapses whose declared id resolves to a matching upstream record — a mechanical sample over the copy link only, never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
m1b_id_resolution_sample.method: seeded simple-random n ≤ 200 per declared id namespace over the run's applied C1 collapses; the origin record is re-fetched by id and checked within tolerance; the verified share carries an exact one-sided Clopper–Pearson α = 0.05 lower bound
m1b_id_resolution_sample.population: a seeded per-namespace sample of the latest completed camera-site ER run's applied C1 collapses

m2_fidelity_sample.label: share of a seeded sample of published sites whose current upstream record still matches on id, point and attributes — a mechanical fidelity sample, never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
m2_fidelity_sample.method: seeded simple-random n = 200 published sites re-fetched from their current upstream by id; the share matching on id, point and attributes carries exact Clopper–Pearson bounds per source class
m2_fidelity_sample.population: a seeded n = 200 sample of the release's published camera-site records, per source class

m3_cross_copy_agreement.label: agreement between copies of one upstream record (coordinate offsets, attributes) — a mechanical census over the run's measured copy links, never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
m3_cross_copy_agreement.population: the applied derivation links (C0–C2) of the latest completed camera-site ER run

m4_perturbation.label: per-class join/no-join outcomes over modelled perturbations of corpus records — a mechanical census against the declared ruleset contract, never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
m4_perturbation.method: known-answer tests: a declared-mirror twin of each sampled corpus record is perturbed per class and resolved by the committed ruleset — the outcome is compared to the declared expectation (modelled perturbations only)
m4_perturbation.population: the committed real-data regression corpus (tests/rdc/data, sig.rdc-corpus/1 v1): 4 committed licence-safe slices evaluated; 3 restricted-lane slices deferred-unmaterialized

m5_hard_negatives.label: share of mechanically-declared known-distinct pairs the matcher merges — a census over the declared negative classes only, never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
m5_hard_negatives.method: a census over mechanically-declared known-distinct pairs — distinct unique ids in one origin namespace (including real co-located records), incompatible declared technologies, and far-apart records sharing a normalised ref — resolved by the committed ruleset
m5_hard_negatives.population: the committed real-data regression corpus (tests/rdc/data, sig.rdc-corpus/1 v1): 4 committed licence-safe slices evaluated; 3 restricted-lane slices deferred-unmaterialized

m9_corroboration.label: share of resolved sites seen by two or more declared independent lineages — a mechanical census over declared independence classes, never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
m9_corroboration.population: the resolved sites of the latest completed camera-site ER run over the release's published member records

auto_positive_precision.label: human-evaluated auto positive precision — never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
auto_positive_precision.population: strict share of sampled auto-positive edges verified same by a human reference

candidate_recall.label: human-evaluated candidate recall — never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
candidate_recall.population: share of the independently referenced same-pair population the candidate generator recovers

cluster_quality.label: human-evaluated cluster quality — never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
cluster_quality.population: pairwise and B-cubed cluster quality against human reference cluster memberships

labelability.label: human-evaluated labelability — never an estimate of real-world precision or recall
labelability.population: decisive share of the human-labelled frame (abstentions counted)

posture: mechanical measures only — the human estimands are unavailable because no independent human evaluation exists

scope.generalisation_limits: these figures measure exactly the populations named — never identity precision across independent sources, candidate recall, organisation identity, coverage completeness, or that a camera exists or operates (SIG-EVAL-006)

populations.corpus: the committed real-data regression corpus (tests/rdc/data, sig.rdc-corpus/1 v1): 4 committed licence-safe slices evaluated; 3 restricted-lane slices deferred-unmaterialized
populations.spine: no completed camera-site ER run — the spine measures report unavailable rather than fabricate

tiers.note: only derivation-collapse tiers (mechanically verified copies of one upstream record) auto-merge — every inferential match is a review-only possible_duplicate
